remarks: This immaculate, recently updated, bright, and sunny second-floor apartment is nestled on a quiet street near public transportation, schools, shops, restaurants, and the newly enhanced Byram Pool, Park, and Marina-offering everything you need!  Enjoy a fabulous open floor plan featuring a spacious living/dining area and a modern kitchen with a quartz island, stainless steel appliances, and stacked washer and dryer in unit. The primary suite is complemented by two additional double bedrooms and a full bath. Ample closet space, central AC, and beautiful hardwood floors throughout.  Includes a one-car garage with additional driveway parking. The expansive fenced backyard provides plenty of space for entertaining or outdoor fun!  Available May 1st, Excellent credit, verified employment and background check required.
